component.name: IPFS Desktop
component.summary: An unobtrusive and user-friendly desktop application for IPFS

description.p: IPFS Desktop gives you all the power of IPFS in a convenient desktop app: a complete IPFS node, plus handy OS menubar/taskbar shortcuts and an all-in-one file manager, peer map, and content explorer.

Use IPFS Desktop to get acquainted with IPFS without needing to touch the terminal — or, if you're already experienced, use the powerful menubar/taskbar shortcuts alongside the command line to make your IPFS workflow faster.

ul.li: Start your node at system startup and control it from your OS system tray
Quickly import files, folders, and screenshots to IPFS
Easily manage the contents of your node (pin, preview, rename, and share)
Visualize your IPFS peers worldwide on an interactive world map
Explore the "Merkle Forest" of IPFS files and content-addressed data
OS-wide protocol handler support for ipfs:// and ipns:// links

screenshot.caption: Status screen showing node bandwidth, peer count, and repo stats
Files screen to inspect, pin, and manage files on IPFS
Explore IPLD data structures and content identifiers
Peers screen visualizing connected IPFS nodes worldwide
Settings screen to configure node behavior and services
